title: Vynca Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: Senior Full Stack Engineer — Vynca, San Mateo California. Full time hybrid, onsite 2 days a week. 5+ years of full-stack engineering experience building production-grade applications. Work on Vynca Clinical software with product, engineering and design teams. Own secure, performant, user-friendly features from API through frontend. Backend: design and implement REST and GraphQL APIs with Python, FastAPI and Strawberry GraphQL. Build services for user interface, authentication and healthcare patient/provider workflows. Model relational data with SQLAlchemy and apply database migrations using Alembic; maintain PostgreSQL and MySQL. Integrate third-party APIs including Salesforce, Google APIs, Slack and healthcare services. Write unit and integration tests with pytest and testcontainers. Implement security, access control and logging. Knowledge of event-driven architecture, CQRS, FHIR, full-text and semantic search. Frontend: build React and TypeScript features with hooks and functional components. Use Material UI, Emotion, Redux Toolkit, Formik, Yup, GraphQL Apollo Client, Axios, Auth0 and protected routes. Write tests using Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright and MSW. Handle file uploads, PDF generation, digital signatures, LaunchDarkly flags and Vite tooling. Requirements: Computer Science degree or related field, 5+ years of software experience, React and TypeScript expertise, relational databases and ORMs, comfortable with git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Agile Scrum and Jira. Preferred: Pydantic, Redis, TypeSense, healthcare FHIR, HIPAA, Auth0, OAuth and coding with engineering peers.

title: Plentific Senior Backend Engineer
description: Senior Backend Engineer — Plentific, remote Europe: UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain or Portugal. The product supports housing maintenance, repairs, payments, notifications, and contractors. Build and operate backend services in Python and Django, Django REST Framework and FastAPI, deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. Design service-oriented APIs, microservices, contracts, integrations and relational database models, and create entity relationship diagrams ERDs and technical designs. Maintain PostgreSQL, Redis and Celery for database optimization, asynchronous workflows and event-driven task processing. Write complex SQL, evolve schemas and perform safe data migrations, optimizing indexes and throughput. Test backend services and integrate automated tests into CI/CD. Add observability through logging, metrics, tracing and alerts and resolve production incidents. Design for security, resiliency, integrity and performance. Own spec-driven development: translate unclear requirements into technical solution designs with service boundaries, schemas, error cases, testing, rollout and rollback. Use AI-assisted coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code or Cursor to implement, review and test changes; inspect generated output for security, maintainability and correctness. Review and refactor legacy code, mentor junior engineers, communicate tradeoffs with product, frontend and QA. Requirements: 6+ years professional software experience, expert commercial Python and Django, PostgreSQL relational schema design, Redis, Celery, REST, distributed systems, AWS and Kubernetes production experience, Docker, CI/CD, software architecture, documentation and tests. Requires current work authorization in listed European countries and substantial UK-hour overlap.

title: Stora Software Engineer II Ruby
description: Software Engineer II Ruby — Stora, UK or EU remote or Belfast hybrid. Mid-level full-time product engineer. Build and improve a Rails-based self-storage management platform for bookings, customer management, facilities and payments. Develop and maintain customer-facing features and internal tools, improve product stability, reliability, application performance and developer experience. Work independently and collaborate with product and stakeholders to define features, deliver from discussion to deployment and resolve issues from monitoring. Write automated tests and review code so production can be deployed frequently. Requirements: three or more years of professional development and at least two years of Ruby on Rails. Strong knowledge of Rails, ActiveRecord, request-response cycle, database migrations and background jobs. Experience with JavaScript and CSS, Ruby and Rails backend APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis and Sidekiq. Frontend uses Hotwire, Turbo, targeted React, ViewComponents, Sass and BEM. Testing with Minitest, Capybara, Selenium or RSpec. Payments use Stripe Connect and Billing. Deployment through GitHub Actions and Heroku. Debug production bugs and review pull requests while communicating trade-offs clearly. Must be based in UK or EU, eligible to work there, motivated to work in a small collaborative product engineering team.

title: Smart Working Senior Frontend Engineer
description: Senior Frontend Engineer React, Next.js and AWS — Smart Working Solutions, remote Pakistan, full-time. Design, build and enhance secure administration portals and dashboards using React, TypeScript, Next.js. Develop Next.js applications using App Router, server components, middleware, API routes and server-side authentication. Implement role-based access control RBAC and backend API gateways. Maintain testing using Vitest, React Testing Library and Playwright, debugging browser and backend integration behavior. Own deployments and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Docker, AWS and optionally GitLab CI or Jenkins. Improve frontend performance, reliability, code quality, application architecture and user experience. Investigate deployment and infrastructure issues independently; collaborate with small engineering team, review pull requests and validate AI-assisted code quality. Requirements: strong commercial React, TypeScript, Next.js and modern JavaScript frontend experience; shipping secure dashboards in production; full familiarity with App Router server components authentication and API routes; frontend test automation; practical AWS and Docker deployment and CI/CD; backend API integration; independent troubleshooting. Nice to have: WCAG accessibility, multilingual applications, RBAC, measured performance improvements, server-side auth and broader full-stack development. Work UK-shift hours and be based in Pakistan.

title: LiteLLM Senior Security Engineer
description: Senior Security Engineer — LiteLLM, Remote United States, 5+ years experience, security-focused engineering. Secure LiteLLM's Python AI gateway application, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and software supply chain. Conduct hands-on security reviews of a production Python codebase, discover new attack surfaces and partner with developers to remediate application vulnerabilities. Own a coordinated vulnerability disclosure and CVE intake program, security incident triage and vulnerability management; maintain threat models as the product evolves. Prevent authorization failures, tenant isolation mistakes, SSRF, command and SQL injection, unsafe deserialization, secrets exposure and common web and API security vulnerabilities. Analyze code with Semgrep, Bandit, CodeQL, Burp Suite and other SAST/DAST tools. Implement secure pipelines for GitHub Actions, Docker containers, build artifacts, packages and dependencies. Familiar with SBOM software bills of materials, Sigstore, Cosign, Snyk, Grype and Trivy for supply-chain security. Develop engineering guidance and secure-by-default practices, debug high-impact security problems and review risk in AI products. Should have previously built or substantially owned an application security program and have strong Python, threat-modeling, cloud security, vulnerability research and engineering collaboration skills. US work location restriction.

title: Taktile Senior Full-Stack Engineer Agent
description: Senior Full-Stack Engineer on AI Agents team at Taktile. Hybrid Berlin, Dublin, Iasi or London. Build an AI agent platform for financial institutions with Python FastAPI backend on AWS serverless, React and TypeScript frontend. Design and ship full-stack features from frontend chat UI to backend agent runtime, including streaming conversations, rich interactions, human approvals and tools integrations. Operate LLM orchestration, tool-calling and agent execution framework, improve failure handling, and own product features from scoping, coding and tests through production release. Collaborate with product and engineering team, review pull requests, expand unit and integration test coverage, improve CI/CD pipelines and production reliability. Use AI development assistants such as Claude frequently but review generated code and verify expected behavior. Provide production support and eventually on-call duties; address security, monitoring and DevSecOps requirements. Tech stack: Python FastAPI, Pydantic, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL or Postgres, DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, API Gateway and serverless architecture, agent tool use and streaming LLM execution. Requirements include ownership of systems, professional full-stack experience, cloud infrastructure knowledge, pragmatic implementation and collaboration in Agile teams.

title: BlancVPN Senior Python Django Backend Developer
description: Senior Backend Developer Python/Django — BlancVPN via Yadda, remote anywhere except restricted countries. Core stack Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery. Build and operate privacy-critical VPN backend services for hundreds of thousands of users, including billing, APIs, back-office workflows and internal administrative systems. Own schema design, PostgreSQL indexing, migrations, SQL query optimization, database correctness and performance. Maintain Redis for caching, distributed locks, task queues, rate limits and high traffic; process asynchronous background tasks with Celery. Manage migrations with Django migrations and Alembic. Monitor and investigate operational incidents using logs, metrics and alerts; build predictable critical paths and stable production releases. Implement secure and maintainable backend services, APIs and task orchestration. Collaborate with frontend, infrastructure, product and support teams. Required: fluent Russian and English B2+, substantial commercial Python 3 and Django experience, expertise in PostgreSQL data modeling, Redis, Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment and observability, remote communication, debugging production reliability. Nice to have Golang and networking fundamentals, ClickHouse analytics, and legacy software modernization.
